The Space at 1505 was perfect for our gathering. It is spacious, clean and well laid out. Wolf and his partner are kind, communicative and extremly responsivie.  I hope to have our spring gala at studio 1505 every year. Thank you Wolf for making our event so special.

review.reviewBody:
This is a photogenic venue, with a friendly and pleasant staff.  It's got a projector and they offer several kinds of layout, to accommodate either seated or standing crowds. It holds about 75 people max. 
Takashi and the other team members work hard to make things go well, and are very gracious and helpful onsite.

This was an awesome venue to host our joint 40th bday party! Takashi was so helpful and patient with all our questions throughout. We had a BYOB gaming party and there was a fridge and freezer on site for drinks, coat rack, and plenty of tables to arrange for the games. All of our guests asked us to do it again next year because they had so much fun. Thanks Takashi!

The venue itself is gorgeous, it has a good rustic vibe going for it. A lot bigger than it looks and a lot of moveability depending on how you set up and what your event is. Host was very kind (and during the online half) communication was on point, reached out in a timely manner even checking back in with us. Would love to use this space again!

acceptedAnswer.text:
Our event spaces are located at the CUNY Graduate Center at 365 Fifth Avenue, New York, NY 10016. Our building is a landmark building, once home of the B. Altman Department Store, on 34th Street, within a few steps of the Empire State Building.

Located on Fifth Avenue between 34th and 35th Streets, the building is two blocks east of Penn Station, one block east of Herald Square, and two blocks west of the 33rd Street and Park Avenue station. mainEntity.name: What kind of events can be used for the event spaces?

acceptedAnswer.text: Event spaces can be used for conferences, receptions, performances, film shoots, screenings, and private events. In the past, our spaces have been rented for the filming of an Amazon original series, important political announcements, as well as company annual meetings, cocktail receptions, business exam prep classes, and a wide array of other events.

mainEntity.name: How many people can your event space hold?

acceptedAnswer.text: Depending on the space you book, we can handle from as little as 10 to as large as 400 attendees. Please check the room page for details on capacity.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to rent the event space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing depends on the space you book, time of year, and services needed. Please fill out our contact form so an event planner can speak with you and provide an estimate.
